papers.title: Impaired hippocampal place cell dynamics in a mouse model of the 22q11.2 deletion.
Vasoactive Intestinal Polypeptide-Expressing Interneurons in the Hippocampus Support Goal-Oriented Spatial Learning.
Hippocampal adult-born granule cells drive network activity in a mouse model of chronic temporal lobe epilepsy.

pipeline_steps.technique: Tamoxifen-induced Cre-dependent tdTomato labeling of adult-born granule cells, kainic-acid induction of the chronic temporal lobe epilepsy model, and viral GCaMP6f injection into dorsal dentate gyrus

parameters.tamoxifen: 3 mg IP/day for 5 consecutive days, 2 weeks before KA injection
parameters.ka_injection: into ventral hippocampus to induce epilepsy model
parameters.virus: AAV2/1:hSyn-GCaMP6f (Addgene 100837-AAV1, >=1x10^12 titer), dorsal DG, -2.3 AP/1.5 ML/-1.8,-1.65,-1.5 DV, 64 nl/site in 32 nl increments

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronically epileptic mice with tdTomato-labeled abGCs and GCaMP6f-expressing DG neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic hippocampal imaging window, LFP electrode, and EMG electrode implantation

parameters.window: 2.0 mm diameter, 2.3 mm height cannula with 2 mm glass coverslip, 100-200 um above the hippocampal fissure
parameters.electrode: custom monopolar electrode for hippocampal LFP and neck EMG
parameters.analgesia: Metacam 5 mg/kg IP, bupivacaine 2 mg/kg SC

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic imaging window and LFP/EMG electrodes

pipeline_steps.technique: Continuous multichannel video-EEG monitoring for seizure and interictal event tracking

parameters.system: custom analog multichannel recording system (NeuraLynx), up to 16 mice simultaneously
parameters.outputs: offline determination of interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs), seizure frequency and duration

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: continuous video-EEG recordings with seizure/IED annotations

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon dual-channel (GCaMP6f/tdTomato) calcium imaging with simultaneous hippocampal LFP recording in head-fixed mice on a treadmill

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.acquisition: 512x512 px, 225x225 um FOV, 8-30 Hz depending on plane count
parameters.lfp_sync: Intan Technologies system, 25 kHz, synchronized to microscope frame-start signal
parameters.habituation: 1 h/day for 3 days before experiment start

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized two-photon calcium imaging and LFP recordings
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker two-photon microscope; Intan Technologies recording system

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging data preprocessing: whole-frame motion correction and Suite2p ROI detection with neuropil correction

parameters.roi_curation: post-hoc Suite2p GUI curation to exclude non-somatic components
parameters.cross_session_tracking: same-FOV recordings concatenated before Suite2p spatial mask calculation

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, neuropil-corrected ROI fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Running-modulation calculation with bootstrap significance testing of event-triggered calcium responses

parameters.response_magnitude: mean post-event minus mean pre-event DF/F
parameters.bootstrap: 3000 resampling iterations with replacement, 99% confidence interval

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell significant positive/negative/non-significant response classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection of sharp-wave ripple (SPW-R) events from LFP via a supervised template-matching classifier

parameters.downsampling: 25 Hz wide-band signal downsampled to 1250 Hz
parameters.channel_selection: wire with greatest ripple-band (100-225 Hz) Gabor wavelet power
parameters.template: k-nearest-neighbor embedding on wavelet-derived SPW-R features, trained on hand-labeled ground truth from 4 separate mice
parameters.threshold: within-event ripple-band wavelet power >=12 MAD above session median
parameters.inclusion: immobility periods >=3 s only; visually verified

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected SPW-R events

pipeline_steps.technique: Semi-supervised classification of interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) via an Online Kernelized Perceptron with iterative human-in-the-loop annotation, and Random Forest cross-validation

parameters.feature: FFT magnitude spectrum of the LFP snippet per imaging frame
parameters.classifier: Online Kernelized Perceptron, Gaussian RBF kernel, sigma=1

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-frame IED classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Classification of adult-born versus mature granule cells (abGC vs. mGC) from IED response profiles via logistic regression and supervised UMAP dimensionality reduction

parameters.responsiveness_metric: mean post-event minus pre-event activity in a fixed 3 s window
parameters.classifier: L2-regularized logistic regression, 80/20 train/test split by cell
parameters.dimensionality_reduction: supervised UMAP, cross-validated on 80%/20% held-out cells

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: abGC/mGC classification accuracy and UMAP embedding

pipeline_steps.technique: Latent ensemble recruitment modeling: a Bayesian generative model estimating sparse cell-ensemble recruitment by interictal spikes and network synchrony events

parameters.activation_binarization: bootstrap procedure, 10,000 resampled trigger frames excluding IEDs/seizures, 95th percentile threshold
parameters.model_structure: Dirichlet-distributed ensemble-recruitment probability vector per event, Bernoulli indicator per cell-event pair, Gaussian-distributed responsiveness conditional on activation state
parameters.synchrony_events: identified via spectral analysis of simultaneous single-channel ipsilateral CA1 LFP

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-cell event responsiveness and LFP-derived synchrony events
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: inferred latent cell ensembles and their event-recruitment probabilities

papers.title: Maximally selective single-cell target for circuit control in epilepsy models.

pipeline_steps.technique: Zebrafish acute chemoconvulsant seizure induction via pentylenetetrazol (PTZ) bath application
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: zebrafish exhibiting spontaneous PTZ-induced seizures

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon volumetric calcium imaging of whole zebrafish brain during baseline and PTZ-induced seizure states, with atlas registration and NMF-based signal extraction

parameters.acquisition: 1.2x zoom (1.44 um/px), 15 z-planes (15 um spacing), 0.59 s/volume, 2500 volumes
parameters.protocol: 5 min baseline, then 15 mM PTZ bath application, 20 min continued imaging
parameters.registration: Z-Brain atlas Tg(elavl3:H2B-RFP) volume via Computational Morphometry Toolkit (CMTK)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single-cell functional calcium dynamics registered to a common brain atlas

pipeline_steps.technique: Mouse intrahippocampal kainic-acid model of chronic temporal lobe epilepsy: tamoxifen-induced adult-born granule cell labeling, kainic acid injection, viral GCaMP6f injection, chronic imaging window and LFP electrode implantation

parameters.tamoxifen: 3 mg IP/day for 5 consecutive days, 2 weeks before KA injection
parameters.ka_injection: kainic acid into ventral hippocampus to induce epilepsy
parameters.virus: rAAV(Syn-GCaMP6f) into dorsal dentate gyrus, ipsilateral to KA injection
parameters.implants: chronic imaging window over dorsal dentate gyrus; LFP electrode adjacent to KA injection site
parameters.monitoring: continuous video-EEG for ictogenesis, individually housed
parameters.imaging_start: 3 weeks post-KA injection, after video-EEG-verified TLE

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronically epileptic mice with dentate gyrus imaging/LFP access

pipeline_steps.technique: Concurrent two-photon calcium imaging of dentate gyrus granule cells and LFP recording in head-fixed epileptic and control mice

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.control_data_source: healthy control recordings from Danielson et al. 2016, matched dentate gyrus location

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised calcium traces and concurrent LFP recordings

papers.title: Recruitment and inhibitory action of hippocampal axo-axonic cells during behavior.

pipeline_steps.technique: Confocal image analysis: laminar cell-body distribution and AAC-AIS 3D distance quantification

parameters.laminar_distribution: cell-body positions marked on maximum-intensity projections relative to manually drawn layer borders, fluorescence intensity normalized to the maximum observed across animals
parameters.3d_distance: OTSU thresholding (mCherry channel) and local Moran's I spatial clustering (p-IkBa channel) to identify positive voxels, converted to point clouds and compared via kd-tree nearest-neighbor distance (3 micron threshold)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: laminar cell distribution and 3D AAC-process-to-AIS distances

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of Unc5b-AAC-innervated AIS ratio

parameters.method: AISs labeled blind to reporter channel via freehand lines, converted to 5-micron-thick measurement areas; fluorescence intensity and thresholded (Huang method) positive-pixel counts measured pre/post 90 degree rotation for normalization
parameters.classification: AIS reporter intensity normalized to the average across all AIS objects in the image; normalized values >1 (with PV-pixel ratio threshold 0.2) classified as axo-axonic-innervated

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: thin z-stacks of AAC reporter and PV/p-IkBa immunostaining
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified AAC-innervated vs. non-innervated AISs

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro electrophysiology intrinsic-property analysis and PCA-based classification

parameters.metrics: input resistance, sag, AP threshold (dV/dt exceeding 3 SD), AP width, afterhyperpolarization, rheobase, upstroke/downstroke velocity, adaptation score, burstiness score, fast/medium AHP
parameters.exclusion: neurons with resting potential above -55 mV or input resistance >500 MOhm excluded
parameters.pca: principal component analysis performed across the full set of extracted intrinsic-property features

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: intrinsic electrophysiological feature set and PCA-based cell characterization

pipeline_steps.technique: Spike-waveform-based cell-type classification and optical photoidentification

parameters.classification: 2D Gaussian mixture model fit to spike width and valley-to-peak time to classify putative pyramidal neurons (n=495) vs. interneurons (n=128); ambiguous units (n=82) excluded
parameters.photoidentification: parameter-free ZETA test (Montijn et al., 2020) on event-aligned spike-time cumulative distributions; peak/trough response latency 1-50 ms required for significance (p<0.01)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified cell types and optically identified putative axo-axonic cells

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium movie preprocessing, ROI segmentation, and cross-session tracking for combined imaging/LFP experiments

parameters.segmentation: Unc5b-AAC ROIs segmented via SIMA's STICA method or manually; other neurons segmented via SIMA's PlaneCA1PC method
parameters.tracking: AACs matched and assigned unique IDs across multiple imaging sessions of the same FOV; unitary response properties computed from all events across sessions

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, segmented, cross-session-tracked dF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Event-triggered average response analysis (whisking, sharp-wave ripples, running)

parameters.whisking_detection: motion-energy map from video, z-scored, positive frames (z>1) clustered via DBSCAN (eps=1s) to define whisking event onsets
parameters.spwr_detection: automatic LFP-based SPW-R detection with manual curation, blind to calcium responses; response quantified from max dF/dt in a 0-100 ms window post-ripple onset vs. 1,000 matched random control events
parameters.averaging_rule: non-overlapping event windows (400 ms minimum gap) averaged first per-ROI then per-cell-type; automated to remove investigator bias

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: dF/F traces, LFP traces, and behavioral video
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: event-triggered average calcium responses to whisking, SPW-Rs, and running onset

pipeline_steps.technique: Unit-unit and population-population correlation analysis

parameters.unit_unit: Pearson correlation between full dF/F traces; time-resolved via rolling +/-1 s windows
parameters.population_population: z-scored dF/F averaged by cell type, resampled into variable-size bins (0.1-10 s) with a temporal shift (-10 to 10 s) applied before binning; correlation computed per bin size/offset after sorting

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: unit-unit and AAC-vs-Other population correlation metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium movie preprocessing and ROI segmentation for optogenetics experiments

parameters.segmentation: Suite2p spatial-mask ROI detection with cross-ROI/neuropil contamination correction, curated post hoc in the Suite2p GUI to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, segmented dF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Stimulation responsiveness and calcium-event quantification

parameters.responsiveness_metric: difference between the activity metric inside the stimulus window and an identical-width pre-stimulus window
parameters.model: linear mixed-effects model (Transients ~ Stim + (1|Animal)) compared to a null model via ANOVA

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: dF/F traces around optogenetic stimulus onsets
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell stimulation responsiveness and transient-rate change significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially tuned cells and place-field detection

parameters.tuning_curve: 2-m belt divided into 100 bins, mean dF/F per bin per lap during running epochs, Gaussian-smoothed (sigma=3 bins) and averaged across laps
parameters.null_model: 100 shuffles of lap-by-lap tuning curves; bins exceeding the 99th percentile of the shuffle distribution classified as place fields
parameters.consistency_filter: place fields required in the same location on at least 3 laps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected place fields

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field remapping and turnover analysis in response to AAC manipulation

parameters.pv_correlation: population vector correlation computed for every pair of spatial bins across PRE/STIM/POST lap blocks
parameters.remapping_quantification: average Pearson correlation of PRE population vectors with POST counterparts, compared against unstimulated control sessions
parameters.turnover_analysis: 2x2 contingency tables of place-field presence in PRE vs. POST for the stimulation-zone quintile, tested with the McNemar-Bowker test

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: detected place fields across PRE/STIM/POST lap blocks
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: remapping magnitude and place-field turnover significance

pipeline_steps.technique: General statistical and modeling framework

parameters.test_selection: appropriate tests selected per study design, assumptions checked via Q-Q or residual plots
parameters.reporting: mean +/- SEM unless otherwise specified, two-sided tests unless noted
parameters.mixed_models: linear mixed-effects models (e.g. Response ~ CellType + Sex + (1|Animal)) compared to null models via ANOVA

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

papers.title: Adaptive stimulus selection for consolidation in the hippocampus.
Inhibitory plasticity supports replay generalization in the hippocampus.

pipeline_steps.technique: Stimulated-cell detection via trial-averaged peri-stimulation time histograms (PSTH), PCA of PSTHs across imaged cells, and k-means clustering to classify cells by stimulation/response status
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cell classification by stimulated/unstimulated and odor responding/non-responding

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection and comparison of sharp-wave-ripple (SWR)-associated highly synchronous events (HSEs) from smoothed population dF/F, with PCA-based comparison of SWR component coefficients between pre- and post-stimulation rest sessions

parameters.hse_threshold: population-average transient exceeding mean by >= 3 s.d.

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: peri-SWR-HSE PSTHs and SWR principal component coefficients per condition/subarea

pipeline_steps.technique: Spiking network model of a CA3 subnetwork (leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with adaptation, random Erdos-Renyi connectivity) implementing a spike-timing-dependent inhibitory plasticity (sSTDP) rule, to generate spontaneous replay

parameters.place_cell_fraction: 50% of PCs, place field covers 10% of track, peak firing rate 20 Hz
parameters.offline_input: random low-level (0.1 Hz) Poisson spiking input during replay phase

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated spontaneous replay sequences

pipeline_steps.technique: Biophysical multi-compartment model of a CA3 microcircuit with realistic ion-channel conductances and afferent input from MEC, LEC, and dentate gyrus, run in the NEURON simulation environment

parameters.compartments: soma, basal dendrites, apical dendrites, placed across SLM/SR/SL/SP/SO strata
parameters.place_field_coverage: 10% of track, peak firing rate 20 Hz

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated intracellular voltage traces and network replay dynamics

pipeline_steps.technique: Abstract schema-based sequence-replay model with a feedforward-inhibition plasticity term, used to formalize the REPLAY estimator and the effect of inhibitory-plasticity parameter alpha on replay fidelity
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated replay sequence estimates under varying inhibition strength

pipeline_steps.technique: Offline cue-place aggregate analysis: binning simulation/imaging time into 100-ms windows, 2D cue-cell vs. place-cell spike-count histograms, Pearson correlation and two-tailed t-test for cue-place functional connectivity, and peri-event z-score analysis around HSEs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cue-place correlation statistics and peri-HSE z-scored histograms

pipeline_steps.technique: General statistical testing framework across the study: normality-dependent choice of paired/unpaired t-test versus Mann-Whitney U-test, two-sided tests, and a priori exclusion criteria for imaging/behavioral quality

parameters.exclusion_criteria: poor imaging windows (low-quality viral expression or scarring); absence of clear SWRs in LFP; failure to progress through behavioral paradigm
parameters.blinding: investigators not blinded during experiments or outcome assessment

pipeline_steps.source_quote: No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample sizes

papers.title: Functional architecture of intracellular oscillations in hippocampal dendrites.

pipeline_steps.technique: Hippocampal LFP measurement and preprocessing (resampling to imaging frame rate)

parameters.acquisition: RHD2132 16-channel amplifier + RHD2000 interface board (Intan Technologies), 10 kHz, with laser-scanning frame trigger and treadmill sync
parameters.resampling: offline resampled to ~440 Hz (occasionally 220 Hz) in sync with imaging frames

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: frame-synchronized LFP trace
pipeline_steps.hardware: RHD2132 amplifier; RHD2000 interface board (Intan Technologies)

pipeline_steps.technique: Behavioral state classification (rest vs. walking/running) from treadmill velocity, and depolarizing-event (DE) rate estimation by state

parameters.de_rate: event count divided by time spent in each behavioral state, concatenated across scans within a segment, epochs >=1 s only

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral state labels and per-state DE rates

pipeline_steps.technique: Theta-band phase/amplitude modulation analysis of dendritic membrane-potential fluorescence using a DFT-based sinusoidal parameter estimator, and DE theta-phase preference via circular (Rayleigh) statistics

parameters.phase_assignment: 0 deg at LFP theta troughs, linear interpolation between troughs
parameters.amplitude_estimator: discrete Fourier transform (DFT) estimator of sinusoidal parameters under additive white Gaussian noise
parameters.de_phase_preference: mean resultant vector of unit-modulus phase values per DE; Rayleigh test, p<0.05

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: theta-filtered LFP and dendritic fluorescence traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-segment theta amplitude/phase estimates and DE phase-preference statistics

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection of hippocampal sharp-wave ripples from LFP recorded during behaviorally still periods

parameters.power_smoothing: squared filtered signal, zero-phase 4th-order 25 Hz low-pass
parameters.thresholding: Tukey IQR score >10 for onset, expanded until IQR <2
parameters.merge_exclude: events <15 ms discarded; events <15 ms apart merged

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected ripple epochs

pipeline_steps.technique: Estimation of theta phase gradient along the dendritic basal-tuft axis via parametric and rank-based nonparametric regression against soma path distance

parameters.somatic_phase_reference: linear regression of basal-dendrite phase vs. path distance, intercept used as somatic phase reference
parameters.parametric: least-squares linear regression of relative phase vs. path distance
parameters.nonparametric: rank-regression of soma path distance rank vs. 20-bin theta phase of minimum membrane potential
parameters.oblique_trunk_decomposition: OLS regression of phase against axial and radial distance components (statsmodels regression.linear_model.OLS)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: phase-gradient regression coefficients and significance, and basal-oblique/basal-tuft phase span

pipeline_steps.technique: Phase modulation of DE amplitude via linear-circular sinusoidal fit

parameters.model: least-squares fit of A(theta) = alpha*sin(theta+phi) + beta to empirical DE amplitude-vs-phase histograms

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: fitted amplitude-phase modulation parameters and significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Peri-ripple analysis of DE rate, DE waveform/amplitude, and membrane-potential trough relative to sharp-wave ripples

parameters.rate_stat: standardized Poisson rate-difference z-statistic comparing in-ripple vs. out-of-ripple DE rate
parameters.waveform: 5-point moving-averaged -dF/F in a +/-100 ms window aligned to DE time
parameters.trough_identification: minimum membrane potential in an expanded +/-200 ms window around ripple power peak

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: peri-ripple DE rate modulation, waveform, and membrane-potential trough metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning analysis of dendritic depolarizing events, including significance testing via a nonuniformity (H) statistic and circular Wasserstein distance between tuning curves

parameters.tuning_curve: track divided into 100 position bins, average DE rate during locomotion per bin
parameters.significance: H statistic of nonuniformity vs. 10,000-permutation shuffle null, p<0.05
parameters.distance_metric: circular Wasserstein (earth mover's) distance between tuning curves

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatially tuned dendritic segments and tuning-curve distance metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Reconstruction of somatic spatial tuning curves as a non-negative linear combination of dendritic tuning curves (NNLS), and tuning resultant-vector analysis of place-field-induction-related tuning changes

parameters.reconstruction: non-negative least squares fit of somatic tuning curve to a basis set of spatially-tuned dendritic curves, evaluated via Spearman's rho against circular Gaussian models
parameters.resultant_vector: complex-number position encoding per DE, normalized [0,1] magnitude as tuning strength; circular SD as tuning variability/diversity

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: dendritic and somatic spatial tuning curves
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: somatic-tuning reconstruction quality and resultant-vector tuning metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Theta-phase modulation analysis of dendritic membrane-potential oscillations (DFT-based amplitude/phase estimation, phase-gradient regression)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: theta-band LFP phase, dendritic fluorescence traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: phase/amplitude of membrane-potential theta modulation per segment
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Theta-band LFP phase was determined by first applying

pipeline_steps.technique: Peri-ripple depolarizing-event rate and waveform analysis

parameters.ripple_detection: 80-220 Hz band-pass filter, IQR-based thresholding of LFP power

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: peri-ripple rate modulation and waveform amplitudes

pipeline_steps.technique: General statistical hypothesis testing across experiments

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

papers.title: Synaptic basis of feature selectivity in hippocampal neurons.
An Intranet of Things approach for adaptable control of behavioral and navigation-based experiments.
Recurrent connectivity shapes spatial coding in hippocampal CA3 subregions

pipeline_steps.technique: Recurrent neural network (RNN) modeling of sparse (proximal) and dense (distal) CA3 subnetworks trained on path-integration and context-switching tasks with L1-regularized recurrent connectivity

parameters.architecture: 100 tanh rate units (LSTM package) recurrent layer, 1-2 dense linear output units
parameters.inputs: instantaneous speed and initial position (path integration); additional noisy binary context signal (multitasking network, Gaussian noise SD=0.3)
parameters.regularization: L1 penalty on recurrent weights, lambda_sparse=0.1, lambda_dense=0.001
parameters.training: Adam optimizer, learning rate 1e-4, minimum batch size 8

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained sparse/dense RNN models and their unit tuning/decoding properties

pipeline_steps.technique: Hopfield network modeling of associative memory storage and recall at varying connectivity sparsity

parameters.network_size: N=1000 binary neurons (varied in a subset of simulations)
parameters.dynamics: classical Hopfield sign-update dynamics until convergence or max iterations
parameters.sparsity_model: Erdos-Renyi structural connectivity matrix at connection probability p, elementwise-masked effective weight matrix
parameters.discrimination_test: storage/recall accuracy (Pearson correlation to ground truth) across varying numbers of stored patterns M
parameters.generalization_test: recall accuracy across varying fraction of flipped neurons at fixed M

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sparse vs. dense Hopfield network storage/recall/generalization performance

pipeline_steps.technique: Sensitivity analysis of manifold-dimensionality sparsity gradient using a small rate-RNN simulation swept across connectivity sparsity levels

parameters.network: N=10 unit rate RNN, ReLU activation, spectral radius rescaled to 0.95
parameters.simulation: 22,000 time steps (200 discarded as burn-in), 10 independent networks per sparsity level, sparsity swept 0-100% in 0.5% increments (201 levels)
parameters.metrics: participation ratio, k90, EV5 dimensionality measures
parameters.regime_comparison: dense (2-20% sparsity) vs. sparse (85-100%) regimes, two-sided permutation test (5000 shuffles), Cohen's d effect size

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sparsity-dependent manifold dimensionality gradient surface and regime comparison statistics
